description: CHARACTERIZATION FIXTURE for saga #811 (issue #816): this locks TODAY'S DEFECTIVE behaviour at the `execute()` stage, not the correct behaviour, and must be FLIPPED to the correct expectation when the #814 `[spec]` ruling lands and #815 implements it. The wall is built now because this defect emits neither a diagnostic nor a crash, so a fixture that merely runs the program passes against the broken build. Fault shape A — an UNRESOLVABLE NAME in argument position. `check()` computes the right answer (`ol-unknown-command`, whose usual stage is `semantic` per spec/error-model.md:97) and `execute()` never consults it, so the statement is discarded whole with no diagnostic and no effect. Nesting the unresolvable name one level deeper changes nothing: the enclosing `print` produces no event and the run reports no diagnostic.
